content:
Hillary Clinton had a two-word send-off for Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-Colo.) after CNN projected the Donald Trump loyalist will lose her reelection bid.

The former secretary of state shared a screenshot of a CNN headline that read: “GOP Rep. Lauren Boebert will lose reelection to Democrat Eileen Laubacher in Colorado, CNN projects.”

Clinton mockingly captioned it, “Bye, Felicia.”

The line, from the movie “Friday,” is commonly used as a taunting way to say farewell.

CNN’s Decision Desk projected that Democrat Eileen Laubacher has unseated Boebert in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District.

The Associated Press, however, has yet to call the race.

As of early Wednesday morning, with 98% of votes counted, Laubacher led with 48.8% to Boebert’s 47.9%, according to AP’s election tracker.

Boebert, meanwhile, insisted Monday that she would not concede.

Clinton and the Colorado Republican have a history of clashes, with Boebert drawing the former first lady’s ire when she shared a photograph of her from what was supposed to be a closed-door congressional deposition related to the investigation into late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
